decisions.reason: As a close extension of its proven space imaging and navigation business, this newly launched camera still has unresolved upside and low enough carrying cost to justify keeping the option open.
The modular camera fits especially well with the firm's stated move toward more flexible spacecraft sensors, so management would likely retain it while market and mission demand continue to unfold.
Although somewhat more exploratory than the core camera lines, the sensor suite builds on existing capabilities and in a growing space market its uncertainty still supports keeping it on the market.

The miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR is strategically relevant for smaller satellites but appears less established commercially, so it has the highest withdrawal risk yet still enough option value to keep for now.
